insight: Spun out of the Stanford AI Lab in 2019; raised a $100M Series D in 2025 at a $1.3B valuation.
name: Snorkel AI
tagline: Data development platform for programmatically labeling AI training data.
description: Enterprise platform for building and curating AI training and evaluation data with programmatic labeling instead of hand-annotating examples one by one. Teams encode domain knowledge as labeling functions that Snorkel Flow applies and refines at scale, then use the resulting datasets to fine-tune and evaluate models.

modelSupport.notes: Produces training/eval datasets for any downstream model.

edge: Programmatic, labeling-function-driven data development that scales annotation far past manual labeling for specialized enterprise domains.
pros: Encode domain knowledge as labeling functions
cons: Steeper learning curve than point taggers
Aimed at ML teams, not individuals

references.title: Snorkel AI raises $100M Series D for its data development platform
